form.label: DOC - Network Baseline Components
form.description: Essential components for establishing comprehensive network baselines using Zeek logs

html.p: This dashboard outlines the essential components required for establishing comprehensive network baselines using Zeek network security monitoring data.

Network baselining involves establishing normal patterns of network behavior to effectively detect anomalies and potential security threats. The following components represent the key areas to monitor and baseline in your network environment.
Source: Zeek (conn.log)
Key Fields: bytes, packets, duration

ul.li: Establish patterns for data transfer rates
Identify normal traffic distribution across time periods
Detect unusual spikes or drops in network activity

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats sum(orig_bytes) as total_bytes, sum(orig_pkts) as total_packets, avg(duration) as avg_duration by _time | timechart span=1h avg(total_bytes) avg(total_packets) avg(avg_duration)

html.p: Source: Zeek (Protocol-specific logs like http.log, dns.log, ssl.log)
Key Fields: proto, service

ul.li: Catalog all protocols in use on the network
Monitor protocol usage trends over time

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by proto, service | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (conn.log, service detection logs)
Key Fields: service, id_resp_p (destination port), id_orig_p (source port)

ul.li: Identify all services running on the network
Map services to specific ports and hosts
Detect unauthorized services or port usage

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by service, id_resp_p, id_resp_h | sort - count

html.p: Source: Raw pcap for IP and MAC addresses; Zeek for higher-level identification (known_hosts.log, dhcp.log)
Key Fields: id_orig_h (source IP), id_resp_h (destination IP), MAC addresses

ul.li: Inventory all devices on the network

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:known_hosts | stats count by host, annotations | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (dns.log)
Key Fields: query, qtype, rcode

ul.li: Monitor DNS query patterns and frequency

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:dns | stats count by query, qtype, rcode | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (conn.log)
Key Fields: conn_state, id_orig_h, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, id_orig_p

ul.li: Identify normal connection states and durations

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by conn_state, id_orig_h, id_resp_h, id_resp_p | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (ssl.log)
Key Fields: version, cipher

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:ssl | stats count by version, cipher, server_name | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (conn.log for TCP errors, dns.log for DNS errors)
Key Fields: TCP flags (within conn.log), rcode (within dns.log)

ul.li: Monitor network error rates and types
Establish baseline for normal error levels

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:conn conn_state!=SF | stats count by conn_state, history | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (files.log, http.log for HTTP file transfers)
Key Fields: filename, mime_type, total_bytes

ul.li: Monitor file transfer patterns and volumes

pre.code: index=zeek sourcetype=zeek:files | stats count, sum(total_bytes) as total_size by mime_type, filename | sort - total_size

html.p: Source: Zeek (Various logs depending on asset type: http.log, ssl.log, conn.log)
Key Fields: id_orig_h, id_resp_h, service, conn_state

ul.li: Monitor behavior of critical network assets
Establish communication patterns for important servers
Detect anomalous activity on critical systems
Track access patterns to sensitive resources

pre.code: index=zeek (id_orig_h IN (critical_server_list) OR id_resp_h IN (critical_server_list)) | stats count by service, id_orig_h, id_resp_h | sort - count

html.p: Source: Zeek (if integrated with authentication logs or custom scripts), raw pcap for basic activity
Key Fields: User IDs (custom scripts or logs), timestamp, id_orig_h, id_resp_h

ul.li: Detect insider threats and compromised accounts
Track user access to resources and systems

pre.code: index=zeek user_id=* | stats count, dc(id_resp_h) as unique_destinations by user_id, _time | timechart span=1h avg(count) avg(unique_destinations) by user_id

html.p: Best practices for implementing network baseline components in your environment.

ul.li: Ensure all relevant Zeek logs are being generated
Set up log forwarding to Splunk
Implement log rotation and archival strategies
Create proper sourcetypes for each Zeek log type
Set up field extractions and data models
Daily: Monitor baseline performance and alerts
Weekly: Review and update baseline lookups
Monthly: Analyze baseline accuracy and adjust thresholds
Quarterly: Comprehensive baseline review and update
